basic_info.description: 1307-1329 Stevenson Street was built in 1907 and is located in Soma. It features 12 unit. All units are 1 bedroom one bathroom. Multiple units in the building have been remodeled within the last 5  years, and there is a lovely garden in the back for tenants to enjoy. The property features a newly serviced acrylic roof and the seismic retrofit is complete. This is a great opportunity for an investor to come in day one and hold a cash flowing property.
